exposure: planned mode of term breech delivery
Planned mode of term breech delivery
cohort: 30,778 nulliparous women with singleton breech delivery at term in Denmark between 1991 and 2018
finding: Planned cesarean delivery in the first pregnancy was associated with a significantly higher risk of uterine rupture in the subsequent pregnancies but not with risk of postpartum hemorrhage, placenta previa, hysterectomy, or stillbirth.
mod_finding: Compared to planned vaginal breech delivery at term, nulliparous women with planned cesarean breech delivery have a significantly reduced risk of postoperative complications but a higher risk of uterine rupture in their subsequent pregnancies.
